maya: Heads-up — during the 2h long-context soak we saw steady memory growth on kv-shard-12. Eviction counter climbed ~12k but overall cache hit_rate barely budged.

ev an: Oof. Can you paste the main metrics and any flamegraphs you grabbed?

maya: Pasted the prometheus snippets and a quick summary below. tl;dr: fragmentation looks likely — many small "resident" allocations with low reuse.

maya: PromQL snippets I ran:
```
# global hit rate over time
sum(rate(kv_cache_hits_total[5m])) / sum(rate(kv_cache_lookups_total[5m]))

# evictions per shard
sum by (shard, reason) (rate(kv_cache_evictions_total[5m]))

# average residency per key size bucket
avg by (size_bucket) (kv_cache_residency_seconds_sum / kv_cache_residency_seconds_count)
```

maya: Quick outputs: evictions concentrated on shard=12, reason=memory_pressure; residency median up ~7x vs baseline; tail of residency distribution stretched.

ev an: Did you capture the allocation histogram or KV slot reuse counters?

maya: Yep. We instrumented `kv_slot_reuse_total{shard="12"}` and `kv_slot_alloc_size_bytes_bucket`. The reuse rate dropped from ~0.82 to 0.54 as long contexts ramped.

priya: That matches fragmentation — lots of small partial KVs preventing reuse of large preallocated blocks. We should add a fragmentation_ratio metric: `1 - (sum(resident_bytes_reusable) / sum(resident_bytes))`.

leo: Agree. Also add `kv_eviction_reason_count` labeled by `reason` and `policy` (LRU vs age vs manual). Dashboards currently only show total evictions which hides the reason mix.

maya: perf-bot posted an automatic regression alert around timestamp 1823456720 (linked). perf-bot: *kv-cache: memory growth regression: +18% memory-per-shard at 95th pct for long-context workload.* :warning:

perf-bot: https://perf.redwood/internal/alerts/4721 (automated)

evan: For observability: propose these panels for the dashboard —
- heatmap: `kv_key_residency_seconds` by shard x residency range (shows fragmentation pockets)
- stacked bar: `kv_eviction_reason_count` by shard (shows reason ratios)
- line: reuse_rate = rate(kv_slot_reuse_total[5m]) / rate(kv_slot_alloc_total[5m])
- correlation panel: overlay `p95_latency_gen` with `rate(kv_cache_evictions_total[1m])` to see tail coupling

priya: Also add a per-shard occupancy histogram: `kv_resident_slots_bucket{shard=~".*"}` so we can see skew across shards.

leo: Small profiling note — our allocator returns many small blocks for >1024 byte keys because of a current quantization threshold. If fragmentation is the root cause, we should evaluate bumping the quantization and enabling slab coalescing for large keys.

maya: I captured a small flamegraph of CPU vs mem churn and attached in the ticket. Key observations: frequent small memcpy paths during KV insertion and many `free()`s concentrated on the same latency windows.

evan: Action items:
- maya: add fragmentation_ratio gauge and kv_eviction_reason_count (prio P0) — target EOD.
- priya: add reuse_rate panel + occupancy histogram to the runtime dashboard (PR to grafana repo).
- leo: prototype slab coalescing change in a dev build and smoke test with long-context generator.
- perf-bot: keep monitoring and send alert if per-shard mem > +12% for 10m window.

maya: filing ticket RD-9873 with traces/promQL/snippets + flamegraph.

priya: can someone add a tiny README in the dashboard folder explaining the new panels and the heuristics they indicate? makes handoffs easier.

leo: I'll put a short note.

maya: thanks team. I'll post updates after the metrics are in. :thumbsup:
